opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality; aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements at universities and research institutes (mostly UK) in Cara's Network.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission providing temporary (standard 2- or 3-year) placements at UK universities and research institutions for academics facing imminent danger, so they can continue their research and teaching until they can return home. Cara checks each applicant's background, qualifications and references, helps identify host institutions, negotiates placements, allocates additional funding from its own resources, and assists with visas and practical arrangements for the Fellow and accompanying family. Applications are considered on a rolling basis.
